record.dic_text:
2883 Kornelios {kor-nay'-lee-os}

源自拉丁文; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Cornelius 10; 10

哥尼流 = "號角"
1) 義大利營的一個羅馬百夫長，駐紮在該撒利亞。這人後來成為基督徒

2883 Kornelios {kor-nay'-lee-os}

of Latin origin;; n pr m

AV - Cornelius 10; 10

Cornelius = "of a horn"
1) a Roman centurion of the Italian cohort stationed in Caesarea who
   converted to Christianity
